final_rationale: RESCUE_001 SURVIVES 102 (no single reference anticipates all 6 limitations). 103 risk is MEDIUM (reduced from V4 HIGH) because: (1) the Minnetronix dual-sensor patent was ABANDONED, reducing motivation; (2) 3 limitations (L2, L3, L5) are missing from both references; (3) the CSF-venous differential is a new signal with functional interaction (not mere aggregation); (4) the occlusion prediction requires fluid dynamics analysis not in the prior art. HOWEVER, 490 external patents have NOT been claim-level searched, so 103 risk is UNCERTAIN. The invention is PROMISING — it has a genuine technical differentiator and survives the strongest known prior art, but has NOT been proven against the full prior-art landscape.
